product_metadata.title: Croydex WC846005AZ Trent Stainless Steel Lockable Surface Mount Medicine Cabinet with Keys, 15.7 x 9.8 x 5.2 In.
features: Stainless steel cabinet with mirrored door
Secure locking system for storage of medicines
description: This medicine cabinet boasts a mirrored door with a secure locking system, offering the peace of mind that your medicines aren't reached by the wrong hands.

Such a practical and neat bathroom cabinet - it not only has storage space, but can be securely locked to keep small hands away from medicines and dangerous drugs. So useful it can be used in other rooms too.
